+    content: str
+
+
+class Argument(BaseModel):
+    id: str

+    content: str

+

+

+        "description": body.description,

+    _arguments[debate_id] = []
+    return debate

+    args_sorted = sorted(args, key=lambda a: a["created_at"])
+    return {"arguments": args_sorted}
